use_conv2d_custom_gradfix: use the custom conv2d function that supports arbitrarily high order gradients with zero performance penalty
use_conv_transpose2d_custom_gradfix: use the custom conv_transpose2d function that supports high order gradients for transposed convolution operations
enable_no_weight_gradients_context: enable the no_weight_gradients context manager to temporarily disable weight gradient computation during forward pass
check_custom_op_compatibility: check if the custom conv2d gradfix operation is compatible with the current PyTorch version and CUDA device
review_conv2d_gradfix_cache: review the conv2d_gradfix caching mechanism that stores Conv2d autograd function classes by configuration key
